game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must hold off rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the market bell. Then check energy and advance.
player_objective: Protect the market bell from rogue knights in Throne Hall: keep energy above zero until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 7, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
